# Preface {.unnumbered}

This handbook collects what the course unit expects you to know about the tools, in a
form meant to be consulted all year rather than read once. Each chapter stands alone;
each ends with a short list of complementary readings.

The first part covers Python and VS Code. It was written after the first fortnight of
the course unit, from the questions raised in the repository's issues, and it is
organised around the one idea behind most of them: a package is installed into one
specific Python, and only that Python can use it.

The source of every chapter is a Markdown file in the
[`01-handbook/`](https://github.com/vlmathieu/firs-uc33-modeling/tree/main/01-handbook)
folder of the repository. Corrections are recorded in the repository's
[`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/vlmathieu/firs-uc33-modeling/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
Questions go to the
[issues](https://github.com/vlmathieu/firs-uc33-modeling/issues/new/choose).
